subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks again for the call today, Jordan — great to meet you and your EngOps team. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: size a Dedicated pool that meets your SLA targets for interactive assistant use across web and mobile.
- Key requirements we discussed: p99 latency target ~250ms for streaming responses, expected concurrent users ~150 active sessions, average request size ~120 tokens, peak burst ~12k tokens/sec (approx).
- Model family: likely an Llama-3 style model (we discussed v3.5/13B as baseline) but we can validate during the sizing call.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute Dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your platform/infra lead + our serving/runtime folks (Rishi + Neha). On that call we'll review the workload snapshot, validate latency SLOs, and propose a Dedicated pool configuration and preliminary cost estimate.

I attached a short "Dedicated sizing" template you can fill with metrics (avg tokens, request distribution, concurrent sessions by region) — if you can drop that before the call it will make the session much more productive.

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Tue 17 Feb, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Tue 17 Feb, 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Wed 18 Feb, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and we’ll accommodate. Also please include whoever owns cloud region selection (we discussed US-West preference) and any SRE/infra folks who will join.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
https://redwood.com

From: Jordan Miller <jmiller@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: EngOps Team <engops@acmeai.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. The team is available and we can do Tue 17 Feb at 10:00 AM PT. I've attached a quick workload snapshot (initial) and added our infra lead, Samir Patel, to the calendar invite (samir.patel@acmeai.com).

Quick fidelity on the numbers you have:
- Concurrent active sessions (expected steady-state): 140–160
- Average tokens per request: 115–130 (120 for planning)
- Burst estimate: ~10k–14k tokens/sec during peak campaigns
- Target p99 latency: 200–300ms (interactive experience)
- Primary region: us-west-2 currently; open to multi-region later

Samir will join on Tue — he can share some internal telemetry during the call. If Rishi & Neha want any more pre-read or metrics formats, let us know.

Looking forward to the sizing session.

Jordan Miller
Senior PM, Platform
Acme AI
jmiller@acmeai.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

Attachments: acme-workload-snapshot.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeai.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Perfect — thanks Jordan. I've created a calendar event for Tue 17 Feb 10:00–11:00 AM PT and invited Rishi, Neha, Samir, and your EngOps alias. Link to the invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/rdw-ACME-3421-sizing

Agenda (60m):
- 10m: quick introductions + scope
- 15m: Acme workload telemetry + sample traces (Samir)
- 20m: Redwood runtime + configuration options (Rishi)
- 10m: sizing outputs, cost estimate, next steps (Neha + Marissa)
- 5m: action items + follow-up

Requested pre-reads (if possible):
- the attached Dedicated sizing template (filled)
- any sample traces or p99/p95 latency histograms you can share

We'll prepare initial Dedicated pool configurations for us-west-2 based on the numbers you shared and bring a fallback plan for burst handling (autoscale + short-term extra capacity). If anything changes on your side, ping me and we'll adjust.

See you Tue at 10.

--
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
